classification: Modern GLO-30 digital surface model crop for geographic context only; not ancient ground, a canonical geography profile, an archaeological footprint, an approved route, or a playable map.

worldPlan.frameProjection: tools/map/geographic_frame.helper.py::make_frame; existing cosine-corrected longitude and north-up frame

source.product: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public, COG tile N31/E034
source.verticalReference: EGM2008 (EPSG:3855), metres, per Copernicus GLO-30 documentation; this source TIFF does not expose a vertical datum tag.
source.acquisitionPeriod: TanDEM-X collection 2011–2015 per Copernicus product documentation; older elevation models may fill local data gaps.

crop.modifications: Pixel-aligned integer window crop and lossless DEFLATE re-encoding only; no resampling, reprojection, value change, filling, smoothing, interpolation, terrain derivation or data completion.

preview.display: YlOrBr scientific surface view with north up, cosine-corrected geographic aspect, P2–P98 stretch; source raster values unchanged.
preview.overlays: Authored bbox, full padded sample-cell bounds, and 22 fictional activity-site candidates from the pinned world plan.
